_meta.notes: PRIVACY ENFORCED: the candidate's PHONE NUMBER is printed IN THE CLEAR on the cover, immediately left of the black bar that covers the fax/email cells (the chunk-file flag is CONFIRMED). FORM FAMILY: this is the older 'SHERRIE SWENSEN' letterhead with NO year in the title, footer 'k://election/candidateinfo/financialdisclosures/04pccfindisc.doc' - form_year is '' (the field exists, no year printed) and the printed stock is not used to date the cycle. Its interim boxes are April 5 / seven days before a primary / September 15 / seven days before a general - a DIFFERENT untitled vintage from the sim_gill filing in this same chunk (April 7 / June 17 / September 15 / October 28). contributions.detail: BASIS TRAP, resolved by scope. The Schedule A grid (p3) is entirely blank - zero rows, a real zero - and its printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE reads '0', matching Summary line 1 Column A ('0'). But the schedule's 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages)' cell carries $39,353.50, which is NOT a sum of this schedule's pages: it is the CYCLE-CUMULATIVE figure and equals Summary line 1 COLUMN B exactly. Reconciling the rows against that cell would manufacture a false $39,353.50 delta. Reconciled against the period figure whose scope matches - summary-line-1 Column A - the side is exact.

expenditures.detail: same inversion on this side: the single Schedule B row 375.00 = printed SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE $375.00 = Summary line 2 Column A = Summary line 6. The schedule's grand-total cell holds $18,181.30, which equals Summary line 2 COLUMN B - the cycle cumulative, a DIFFERENT SCOPE. Gating on the schedule grand total here would fabricate a $17,806.30 delta.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p3 rows 0.00 = printed subtotal '0'; p4 rows 375.00 = printed subtotal $375.00. Both page subtotals are the PERIOD figures and both gate. The schedules' grand-total cells are cumulative and were deliberately NOT used as gates.
